self.why: Byte-for-byte the goal: it is the goal.

dot-slash.why: Links written ./about.html go to the same pages; nothing a person can see differs.

hash-team.why: About links jump to the team card on the right page; that works and looks the same.

root-slash.why: /about.html works on a site served from its root; identical to the eye.

query.why: about.html?ref=nav opens the same page on any static host; identical to the eye.

upper-case.why: ABOUT.html opens on Windows or Mac hosting but 404s on most Linux hosts, so a careful lead would flag it, though it looks identical.

image-link.why: The hero button is an image with alt text that links to pricing; it works and looks the same apart from a few pixels.

btn-nav.why: Every link works; the menu items are filled pills instead of plain text, a visible but small style change.

footer-nav.why: Everything is reachable, but the header menu is gone and the links sit in the footer: one obvious visible difference.

two-clicks.why: Contact is missing from the menu and is reached only through a button on About: works, but harder to find.

extra-links.why: Same site plus a row of working footer links; harmless addition.

extra-page.why: Same site plus a linked site map and a 404 page; harmless, arguably better.

nav-hash.why: The About menu item does nothing on every page (About still reachable from a pricing button): an obvious broken link everywhere.

nav-empty.why: href="" just reloads the page, so the About menu item is broken on every page.

nav-js-void.why: javascript:void(0) does nothing, so the About menu item is broken on every page.

nav-typo.why: The About menu item leads to a 404 on every page: a dead link repeated four times.

nav-external.why: The About menu item sends the visitor to someone else's website on every page.

all-home.why: Every link goes to the home page, so three of the four pages can never be reached by a visitor.

contact-self-only.why: The Contact page exists but nothing leads to it except itself: one page unreachable and missing from the menu.

contact-hidden-only.why: The only link to Contact is hidden, so a visitor cannot reach it and the menu is visibly one item short.

one-dead.why: One footer link on one page 404s among about thirty working links: a small flaw.
In a two-page site with three links, the only way back home from About is dead: a third of the navigation is broken.

one-page.why: All the content is there on one long page with anchor links, but it is not the four-page site asked for.

renamed.why: Same site with different file names (about-us.html) and consistent links: a visitor sees no difference, only the URLs.

subfolder.why: Pages live under pages/ with correct links and styles; the site looks and works the same.

merged.why: Contact content is appended to About and the Contact page and menu item are gone: content present, a page missing.

extra-copies.why: The site is perfect but ships an unlinked duplicate of every page: sloppy junk a lead would ask to delete.

home-is-home-html.why: The home page a visitor lands on is a bare 'Enter the site' button; the real home is one click further and the menu points there.

minified.why: Identical look, every link works, noticeably smaller: should beat the goal a little.

css-split-6.why: Same bytes split over six stylesheets: more requests, a minor engineering point nobody would raise hard.

css-inline.why: All CSS repeated inline in every page: a bit more weight, fewer requests, looks identical.

unused-200k-linked.why: Looks identical but every page loads a 200 KB stylesheet that is never used: many times heavier than needed.

base64-250k.why: A 13-pixel footer icon carries 250 KB of base64 on the home page: the home page is tens of times heavier for nothing.

outside-20.why: Twenty stylesheets from an outside server that fail to load: looks fine, but slow and broken requests on every page.

bloated-2x.why: Identical but twice the size through comments and whitespace: a weakness worth a note, not a disaster at this size.

unlinked-200k-file.why: A 200 KB stylesheet sits in the site but no page loads it: dead weight a lead would ask to delete, visitors never download it.

self.why: Byte-for-byte the goal, including ../index.html links from the sub-folder.

folder-link.why: Links to docs/ instead of docs/index.html open the same page on any static host.

dotdot-roundabout.why: Links like ../docs/guide.html from inside docs/ resolve to the same pages; nothing visible differs.

flattened.why: The docs pages moved out of the sub-folder (docs.html, guide.html) with working links; same site, different URLs.

one-css.why: The two stylesheets merged into one: identical look, one request fewer.

broken-css-path.why: The three docs pages load no styles at all (wrong path) and look like raw HTML; only the home page is right.

files-41.expect: A clear refusal saying the site has more than 40 files.
files-41.why: The rule is stated; going over it should be refused with the limit named.

file-over-300k.expect: A clear refusal naming big.css and the 300 KB per-file limit.
file-over-300k.why: The rule is stated; the player needs to know which file is too big.

not-html.why: About is unstyled plain text with no menu, a dead end; the other three pages are right.

empty-index.why: A visitor opening the site sees a blank page and cannot reach the three good pages.

css-only.expect: A clear refusal saying the site has no HTML page (or no index.html), or 0 with that reason.
css-only.why: There is no site to look at.

space-in-path.why: The stylesheet is named 'site styles.css' and linked as site%20styles.css; it loads and the site is identical.

dotdot-path.expect: A clear refusal naming ../outside.css as outside the site, or that stray file ignored and the rest graded near 100.
dotdot-path.why: A path that climbs out of the site is invalid; the player needs to know which one.

backslash-path.why: styles\site.css is the same file as styles/site.css on Windows; the site renders identically (a clear refusal would also be acceptable).

missing-first.why: One route page of twelve is missing and its button is gone from the index: one page of thirteen absent.

missing-last.why: Same flaw as missing-first, on the page that sorts last; a person charges it exactly the same.
